ASR_LINKS#0.quote: The cities of Guwahati in the west and Dibrugarh in the east with good rail, road and air connectivity are the two important nerve centres of Assam

ASR_AIR#0.quote: The Lokpriya Gopinath Bordoloi International Airport is the 10th busiest in India, and the busiest in the Assam and North-East of the country.

SKR_RAIL#0.quote: The closest major railway stations are Siliguri Junction and New Jalpaiguri in neighbouring West Bengal.

SKR_ROAD#0.quote: National Highway 10 (NH 10; formerly NH 31A) links Siliguri to Gangtok.
